privacy.why: Home folders in examples and tests use made-up names. New ones use alex or sam; the others are short placeholders already in the tests.

secrets.why: Shapes of real credentials. The masker's tests hold made-up ones, so their files are exempt.

language.why: Code, comments, docs and commits are English. Japanese is the content of these files.

spacing.why: Japanese strings put a half-width space between Japanese and Latin letters. A digit may sit right before a counter or unit (5時間, 1つ); other digit contacts are warnings.
